statusSeparation.evidenceStatus: Whether the recorded evidence is complete, internally consistent and reproducible.
statusSeparation.stable60FpsStatus: Whether valid evidence satisfies all stable-60 performance gates.
statusSeparation.hypothesisSupportStatus: Whether the valid result supports the stated performance hypothesis.

sixtyFpsRatio.definition: Fraction of measured frames with frameMilliseconds <= 16.6666666667

frameBudgetOverrunRate.definition: Fraction of measured frames with frameMilliseconds > 16.6666666667

maximumFrameMilliseconds.definition: Maximum frameMilliseconds in the measured interval

gpuTimingCoverage.definition: Frames with a finite non-negative gpuHairMilliseconds value / measured frames

vramSlopeMbPerMin.definition: Least-squares slope of sampled GPU memory usage against elapsed minutes

ramSlopeMbPerMin.definition: Least-squares slope of sampled system memory usage against elapsed minutes

p99DegradationRatio.definition: p99 of final 10 percent of measured frames / p99 of first 10 percent

queryUnresolvedSlope.definition: Unresolved GPU timing query count normalized per measured hour

missingEvidencePolicy: A missing required metric is unavailable evidence and must never be replaced with a proxy or zero.
